I don't have access to the salience file path you've referenced (`~/wiki/wizard/packet-v4-3-current/mmm/mini/full/voices/md/MMM_VOICE_ORWELL_FULL_v4_1.md`), and that path doesn't exist in your system.

More importantly: the target claim conflates two independent concerns — repository state (dirty files) and merge mechanics (applying commits) — without stating whether conflicts or file mutations are the actual blocker.

**Boundary without bridge:** The claim moves from "files are dirty" to "commits don't apply" as if they're causally identical, when git merge behavior depends on *conflict*, not *dirtiness*.
